g.text: Official reference audit and idiomatic k-nucleotide probe
Local profile | quiet eight-round rotating confirmation | eight elapsed-time samples per program
Each candidate is divided by its own language/problem before baseline. Below 1x is faster.
* adopted. Dots: median; whiskers: candidate interquartile range divided by baseline median. Absolute medians are in the CSV.
Focused probes are separate from full-suite calibration. Java includes fresh-JVM startup/JIT. Canonical-size timing remains unrun.
